ownership.quote: Anthropic, PBC ... is an American artificial intelligence (AI) public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco, California. ... The company is privately held but reportedly plans an initial public offering in 2026.

stage.quote: In May 2026, Anthropic announced it had raised $65 billion of investment from multiple investors, including Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer Investment Group, and Sequoia Capital. The investment round valued the company at $965 billion.
stage.note: Anthropic is well past a lettered 'series' framework (Series B->E->F->G, plus large strategic rounds from Amazon/Google and a May 2026 $65B round at $965B valuation, reported by Reuters as a 'Series H'). Mapped to series-d+ as the closest bucket for a company this far along; a public IPO is reportedly planned for 2026 but had not occurred as of the checked date.

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of publicly reported rounds/investments per Wikipedia (sourced to TechCrunch/CNBC/Reuters/Anthropic press releases): $124M seed (2021) + $580M incl. FTX (Apr 2022) + $1.25B Amazon (Sep 2023) + $500M Google (Oct 2023) + $2.75B Amazon (Mar 2024) + $4B Amazon (Nov 2024) + $1B Google (Mar 2025) + $3.5B Series E (Mar 2025) + $13B Series F (Sep 2025) + $30B Series G (Feb 2026) + $65B (May 2026) ≈ $121.7B. No single aggregator total was found confirming this exact sum, so it is an estimate computed by this researcher from confirmed individual rounds, not a press-stated cumulative figure.

note: Anthropic is the company behind Claude / Claude Managed Agents (the sandbox/runtime product this card describes), not a standalone sandbox startup. It is a private, VC- and strategic-backed AI foundation-model company (major investors/strategic partners include Amazon and Google, both also its primary cloud infra providers) reportedly worth $965B post-money as of May 2026, with a widely reported plan to IPO in 2026 (not yet public as of the 2026-09-30 check date). Revenue and funding figures reflect the whole company, not the Managed Agents / sandbox product specifically, which is a beta feature (since 2026-04-08) inside the Claude platform rather than a separately monetized business line.
